notes.title: Announcement of the new fourth floor and mini-updates
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44868975/1f42d4fd97a45c8363fa2f0be6e56b9a3d33dfe5.png[/img]
On the fourth floor, a sinister new enemy lies in wait—a terrifying mutation of devils. Your mission? Find the weapon that can end its reign of terror. But it won’t be easy. Before you can lay your hands on it, you’ll need to outwit the monster lurking in the shadows, using clever tricks and solving a series of devious challenges. Can you survive the hunt and claim your prize, or will the nightmare claim you first?

notes.title: Fourth Level
notes.notes: [b]The fourth level is already in development and will be available soon![/b]
